quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI content moderation platform that reviews millions of posts a day for major social platforms.
quests.correctAnswer: It reviews millions of posts a day with more consistency than a tired human team, and without a single moment of burnout.
quests.hint: Lead with scale plus consistency plus the human cost avoided.
quests.explanation: Scale, consistency, and protecting people from a genuinely difficult job together make a compelling three-part case.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a generative writing tool that drafts distinct marketing messages for different customer groups at once.
quests.correctAnswer: It drafts a distinct message for every customer segment at the same time - personalised outreach no single copywriter could match alone.
quests.hint: Open with the simultaneous scale of personalisation.
quests.explanation: Scale of personalisation is the value that separates this from any single generic template.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a document review tool that flags risky clauses in a contract before a lawyer even opens it.
quests.correctAnswer: It flags the risky clauses in hours, not weeks, so the lawyer's time goes toward judgement, not toward reading everything from scratch.
quests.hint: Start with time saved plus what the human still does best.
quests.explanation: Freeing an expert's time for judgement, not reading, is the clearest way to explain how AI and people work together.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a surgical robot that lets a specialist guide an operation in a rural hospital from another city.
quests.correctAnswer: A specialist guides the procedure remotely, so patients in a small rural hospital get the same expert care as a major city clinic.
quests.hint: Begin with the geographic access this creates.
quests.explanation: Extending specialist care to places that never had it is a genuine, moving health-equity story.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a warehouse robot system that cuts order-picking time by sixty per cent without adding staff.
quests.correctAnswer: Orders leave the warehouse sixty per cent faster, with the same team - no extra hires, just far less walking.
quests.hint: Anchor the pitch in the specific sixty per cent improvement.
quests.explanation: A specific, credible number makes an efficiency claim feel measured rather than exaggerated.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an app for parents that logs a baby's feeding, sleep, and nappy changes so both partners stay in sync.
quests.correctAnswer: One log, updated by whoever's on duty, so neither partner ever has to ask 'did you already feed her?' at 3am.
quests.hint: Picture the exact tired, half-asleep question this prevents.
quests.explanation: A precise, exhausted 3am moment is instantly familiar to any new parent and makes the app feel real.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a supply chain platform giving luxury goods a digital record from raw material to store shelf.
quests.correctAnswer: Every luxury item carries a full digital record from raw material to shop shelf, making a convincing fake almost impossible to fake.
quests.hint: Centre the pitch on the near-impossible-to-counterfeit claim.
quests.explanation: Near-impossibility of counterfeiting is about as strong a claim as luxury authentication can credibly make.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a neighbourhood app connecting residents who want to carpool the same daily commute.
quests.correctAnswer: Match with a neighbour driving your exact route, and split the cost of a commute you were paying for alone anyway.
quests.hint: Ground the answer in cost-splitting on a trip already being made.
quests.explanation: Splitting a cost already being paid, rather than adding a new one, is an easy, low-risk pitch.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a property investment platform that lets people invest in premium real estate from a small starting amount.
quests.correctAnswer: Own a small share of a premium property from just a modest amount, an asset class that used to be reserved for the wealthy alone.
quests.hint: Lead with the low minimum opening up access.
quests.explanation: A low minimum combined with a premium asset is the classic democratisation pitch investors respond to.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AR training tool that overlays step-by-step instructions onto real equipment for new employees.
quests.correctAnswer: Instructions appear right on the real machine, so a brand-new employee performs the task correctly on day one, not week three.
quests.hint: Open with day-one correct performance.
quests.explanation: Correct performance from day one is a dramatic, believable improvement over a typical training ramp-up.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family app that plans a weekend day trip based on everyone's energy levels and the weather forecast.
quests.correctAnswer: It checks the forecast and how tired everyone actually is, then suggests a day trip nobody will secretly want to cancel.
quests.hint: Focus on avoiding the cancelled plan, not just suggestions.
quests.explanation: Preventing the classic cancelled weekend plan is a small, honest, very relatable family win.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a VR therapy tool that treats phobias through carefully controlled, gradual virtual exposure.
quests.correctAnswer: Patients face their fear gradually in a fully controlled virtual space - the same gold-standard therapy, now available far beyond a specialist clinic.
quests.hint: Start with clinical quality made newly accessible.
quests.explanation: Making a gold-standard treatment more widely available is a genuine health-access improvement, not just a novelty.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a smart building platform that cuts a building's energy use without any disruption to the people inside.
quests.correctAnswer: Sensors quietly retune heating, cooling, and lighting through the day, cutting energy use by a third without a single person noticing the difference.
quests.hint: Begin with the savings and the no-disruption promise together.
quests.explanation: Removing disruption is what removes the main objection people have to any building-technology upgrade.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription app for parents that sends one screen-free activity idea every afternoon for young children.
quests.correctAnswer: One simple, screen-free idea lands every afternoon, so 'I'm bored' never quite makes it out of a child's mouth.
quests.hint: Name the exact phrase parents dread hearing.
quests.explanation: Naming a specific, familiar phrase makes a simple activity idea feel like it was written just for that household.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a factory sensor platform that predicts machinery failure three weeks before it actually happens.
quests.correctAnswer: A machine's failure is flagged three weeks out, turning a surprise breakdown into a planned repair on someone's own schedule.
quests.hint: Anchor the pitch in the three-week advance prediction.
quests.explanation: Turning a surprise into a planned event is a genuine operational shift, not just a minor convenience.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a community solar programme that lets apartment renters own a share of a solar farm without a roof of their own.
quests.correctAnswer: Own a small share of a solar farm and see the credit on your own electricity bill, even without a roof to put panels on.
quests.hint: Centre the pitch on the roofless access this opens up.
quests.explanation: Removing the need for a personal roof opens clean energy ownership to renters who were previously left out entirely.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription box that sends everything needed for one themed date night at home each month.
quests.correctAnswer: Every box brings a full evening - recipe, activity, and playlist - so date night happens even on the busiest month.
quests.hint: Sell the whole evening, not the individual items.
quests.explanation: Selling a complete, ready-made evening removes the planning effort that often stops date night from happening at all.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a green hydrogen platform that turns surplus renewable electricity into storable, usable fuel.
quests.correctAnswer: When the grid makes more clean power than it can use, this turns the surplus into hydrogen fuel instead of simply wasting it.
quests.hint: Ground the answer in the surplus-to-fuel conversion.
quests.explanation: Rescuing energy that would otherwise be wasted turns a technical process into a very tangible saving.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a sustainable packaging startup making compostable containers from agricultural waste that would otherwise be burned.
quests.correctAnswer: Crop waste that used to be burned now becomes packaging that fully breaks down in months, not centuries.
quests.hint: Lead with the waste-to-product origin story.
quests.explanation: A clear waste-to-product story, paired with genuine biodegradability, makes a strong, complete sustainability pitch.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an app that helps siblings split the care of an ageing parent fairly across different cities.
quests.correctAnswer: Tasks, visits, and costs are shared and tracked fairly between siblings, even when they live in three different cities.
quests.hint: Open with fairness across distance, not just task tracking.
quests.explanation: Solving fairness between siblings addresses a genuinely difficult family conversation, not just a logistics problem.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a wearable skin patch that continuously screens for early warning signs of skin cancer.
quests.correctAnswer: Worn like a regular plaster, it quietly screens the skin underneath day and night, catching a warning sign long before it would ever prompt a visit to a doctor.
quests.hint: Start with catching it early, before any doctor's visit.
quests.explanation: Catching a problem before an appointment is even booked is one of the most persuasive claims in preventive health.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a satellite monitoring platform that gives farmers daily crop health data instead of a monthly estimate.
quests.correctAnswer: Every farmable acre is photographed daily instead of monthly, catching a problem in the field while there's still time to fix it.
quests.hint: Begin with the daily frequency versus the old monthly gap.
quests.explanation: Daily data instead of monthly data is a genuine step change from what precision farming used to offer.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription app that gently teaches an adult a new skill in fifteen minutes a day.
quests.correctAnswer: Fifteen minutes a day, and a skill you've always meant to learn quietly becomes one you actually have.
quests.hint: Anchor the pitch in the small time commitment, not the skill list.
quests.explanation: A small, believable daily commitment removes the biggest excuse adults give for never starting something new.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a commercial space tourism training programme preparing private citizens for their first flight.
quests.correctAnswer: Civilians train on the same rigorous programme once reserved for professional astronauts, before the most extraordinary trip of their life.
quests.hint: Centre the pitch on the professional-grade programme as the trust signal.
quests.explanation: Borrowing the credibility of a professional programme builds the safety confidence this new industry depends on.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a cybersecurity tool for small businesses that explains every alert in plain, non-technical language.
quests.correctAnswer: Every alert comes with a plain-language explanation, so a small business owner finally understands the risk instead of just clicking it away.
quests.hint: Ground the answer in clarity for a non-expert audience.
quests.explanation: Making a technical alert understandable is what actually gets a small business owner to act on it.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family app that automatically splits an inherited house's costs and decisions fairly between siblings.
quests.correctAnswer: Every repair, bill, and decision about the family home is tracked and split fairly, so inheritance stops being the thing nobody wants to discuss.
quests.hint: Name the difficult conversation this app makes easier.
quests.explanation: Making a genuinely difficult family conversation easier gives a practical app real emotional value.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a soil sensor platform that waters crops only where and when they genuinely need it.
quests.correctAnswer: Sensors read moisture at every depth and water only where it's truly needed, cutting water use by nearly half across the whole field.
quests.hint: Lead with the specific water-use reduction.
quests.explanation: A specific, credible saving is a strong case in any region where water is scarce or expensive.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a battery technology company whose cells store far more energy in the same amount of space.
quests.correctAnswer: The same size battery now stores far more energy, so an electric car goes twice as far and recharges in minutes, not hours.
quests.hint: Open with the concrete consumer outcomes, not the raw specification.
quests.explanation: Translating a technical improvement into a real outcome - range and charging time - makes it meaningful to anyone.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a home organisation service that helps a family downsize before a move without the usual overwhelm.
quests.correctAnswer: A guided sort through decades of belongings turns downsizing from an overwhelming weekend into a calm, manageable week.
quests.hint: Start with the emotional relief, not just the sorting.
quests.explanation: Naming the emotional weight of the task, not just the physical sorting, is what makes this pitch land.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a construction material that uses captured carbon dioxide to become stronger than standard concrete.
quests.correctAnswer: Captured carbon dioxide is mixed straight into the concrete, making it both stronger than the standard mix and carbon-negative at the same time.
quests.hint: Begin with the paradox - CO2 strengthening, not polluting.
quests.explanation: A genuine paradox, pollution making something stronger, is an instantly memorable and credible pitch hook.
